meta.name: frame-logo-outro
meta.description: Logo 分块组装入场 + glow bloom + tagline 揭示, 适合视频片尾 / 品牌闭幕

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为视频添加品牌闭幕动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频结尾制作品牌动画
copy.tagline_en: Add brand closing animation to videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create brand animation for video endings

howto.what: 生成一个 1920×1080 的视频片尾品牌帧:logo 由几何块拼装入场,带光晕扫光,随后显示品牌名、tagline、底部 CTA,输出为单文件 HTML。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作视频片尾、品牌收尾帧或 logo-outro 风格结束画面时触发。
howto.what_en: Generates a 1920×1080 brand outro frame: the logo assembles from geometric blocks with a glow/bloom sweep, then the brand name, tagline, and bottom CTA appear — all in a single HTML file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a video outro, brand end-card, or a logo-outro style closing frame.

say_en.text: Make a logo outro for my video, brand 'Aurora', tagline 'Light in motion'.
say_en.note: Outputs a single-file HTML end card.

say_en.text: Do a Solar Amber end card, brand 'Nova', CTA 'nova.dev' at the bottom.
say_en.note: Uses the warm amber accent palette.

say_en.text: Use Bone & Ink style for the outro, brand 'Editorial', tagline 'Think slow'.
say_en.note: No neon glow; uses shadows instead.
